signals.t: Broad forced selling across the universe
signals.ev: 138 of 241 names fell 5%+ in a session with SOX -8.2% and a median move of -5.7%. Everything falling together is a liquidity event, not a fundamental one.
signals.action: Do not buy the first day of a deleveraging — supply is forced and price is not information. Build the staged-entry list now and add only as breadth stabilises. Insulated chokepoints already past the −15% threshold: CDNS, ASML, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, 8035.T, VACN.SW, MKSI, ASM.AS, ONTO.
